checks.reason: The complete replacement faithfully renders 三年，遣其世子俊與恪率騎萬七千東襲夫餘，克之，虜其王及部眾五萬餘口以還. It keeps the bare literal third year without supplying an era or 十; makes Jun and Ke jointly the sent leaders of 率騎 (matching the en field and parallel 率騎 uses at s0034, s0047, s0101 and s0103, where 率騎 means leading cavalry); keeps seventeen thousand cavalry, the eastward raid on Puyu, its capture, the captured king, and 部眾五萬餘口 as more than fifty thousand persons (口), consistent with 部眾 as followers or people at s0071 rather than a separate military division. Tongjian 97’s 世子俊帥…慕容恪…萬七千騎 and 部落 are compatible; the replacement does not adopt Tongjian’s added commanders. No date, identity, merger or Chinese emendation is implied. The en field needs no parallel change.
checks.after: In the third year, he sent his heir apparent Jun and Ke to lead seventeen thousand cavalry eastward in a raid on Puyu. They took it, captured its king and more than fifty thousand of its people, and returned.

cautions: Editorial wording review only; this is not date, identity, chapter or publication approval. 三年 remains the frozen source reading; the competing Yonghe 3/347 and Huang year 13 (Tongjian Yonghe 2/346) interpretations stay unresolved and no 十 is supplied.

Non-blocking observation outside the assigned ID: s0034 en renders 率騎追戰 as counterattacked, while the literal correctly has led cavalry to pursue battle; it was not treated as a definite record defect here.
